title: The Shield That Blocks
setup: Black's bishop has retreated to g8 beside its own king, and your rook is already sitting on f8 beside it.
hint: The piece in front of the king is the same piece holding the back rank shut. Make it choose.
explanation:
## The Idea

The bishop on g8 both shields the king and plugs the eighth rank. {{Rxg8+}} removes it with check, {{Kxg8}} is forced, and {{Re8#}} arrives on the file the other rook has had to itself all along.
